resources.string: Live readings from the IIO devices on the T3 Gemstone O1

No IIO device found under /sys/bus/iio/devices.\n\nThe board sensors need their kernel drivers: LPS22DF through st_pressure_spi and HDC2010 through hdc2010. The ICM-20948 has no driver in this kernel and stays on spidev.
Cannot read /sys/bus/iio/devices — the app is missing the sepolicy rules it needs.
